datasets.label: IBTrACS v04r01 North Indian Ocean best track (IMD / RSMC New Delhi)
Indian coastal state and district boundaries (geoBoundaries gbOpen, ODbL 1.0)

methodology: Best-track positions come from IBTrACS v04r01 for the North Indian Ocean, which republishes the IMD / RSMC New Delhi best track alongside other agencies.
Wind and pressure prefer the IMD columns (NEWDELHI_WIND, NEWDELHI_PRES) and fall back to WMO then JTWC values for seasons that predate them.
Saffir-Simpson category comes from USA_SSHS, with the IMD grade (Depression through Super Cyclonic Storm) carried alongside on every point.
A landfall is the first track position inside an Indian coastal district polygon after the storm was last over water; state and district come from that polygon.
